tags.name: Ambohimitsimbina
tags.note: Previous district name is Antananarivo Renivohitra (MDG11101)
tags.source: Note that Communes (admin 3) have become the District (admin 2) level in the old Antananarivo- Renivohitra district. Therefore district codes have been made the same (with an 'A' suffix) as the Commune Codes for Tana 1-6.
